name: Std.Commutative

source.code:
/--
`Commutative op` says that `op` is a commutative operation,
i.e. `a ∘ b = b ∘ a`.
-/
class Commutative (op : α → α → α) : Prop where
  /-- A commutative operation satisfies `a ∘ b = b ∘ a`. -/
  comm : (a b : α) → op a b = op b a
